item.title: Lazarus and the Rich Man
item.description: This video is inspired by Jesus' parable of Lazarus and the Rich man. Who is Lazarus today? Art and text from "Jesus and the Poor" by H. Deborah Shively, illustrated by J.L. Shively, available in paperback from Amazon.

item.title: The Jezebel Influenced Pastor
item.description: It has been prophesied that the Jezebel spirit will be the prevailing spirit in the church in the United States in the latter days. This video shows us how to know when a pastor or an individual is under the influence of a Jezebel spirit. "The Jezebel Influenced Pastor" is an excerpt from "The Jezebel Agenda" by H.D. Shively, available on Amazon.

item.title: And Am I Born To Die?
item.description: And Am I Born To Die? This is a classic Christian hymn song from the 18th century. The melody and the lyrics are 100% in the Public Domain. The lyrics are by Charles Wesley published in 1763. The melody is adapted from the song “Idumea” published by Ananias Davisson in 1816. The © applies to the arrangement and sound recording only. item.title: Just Give Me Jesus
item.description: Just Give Me Jesus © D.N.W. This is a modern original Christian Country Gospel song. The melody used in Just Give Me Jesus is loosely based on a public domain song titled Bonnie Prince Charlie, circa 1880s. Bonnie Prince Charlie is a traditional Scottish folk song. Bonnie Prince Charlie was also the melody used for the hit country gospel song I Saw The Light by Hank Williams Sr. that was published in 1948.
